limits: Four simultaneous human controllers and every port/reconnect permutation untested.
Physical stock-64-MB console and constrained allocation budget unverified.
Cold-start repetition, all themes/speeds/multiball combinations, long soak and settings-reload acceptance remain open.
Captured audio has not had human listening review.
No game-side audio underrun instrumentation; capture counters are not game underrun counters.
